content:
Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University (BRABU) has published the 5th Provisional Selected Student List (Merit List) for UG CBCS Session 2026–2030.

Subject-wise lists cover undergraduate programmes such as BA, B.Sc and B.Com. Selected students must complete document verification and enrollment at the allotted college within the university schedule.

How to check

  1. Visit brabu.ac.in
  2. Open UG Admission / UG CBCS 5th Provisional Selected Student List
  3. Download subject-wise PDFs
  4. If selected, report to college with original documents and fee

Also check related cutoff notices published under UG admission on the university site.
